targets.rawSql: SELECT g.id AS id, g.name AS name, g.type AS type, if(u.v IS NULL, 'down', 'up') AS status, c.v AS vcpus, ms.v AS memsize, if(ms.v>0 AND g.template!='1' AND u.v=1, mu.v/ms.v*100, NULL) AS memusage_percent, ds.v AS disksize, if(ds.v>0 AND g.type='lxc', du.v/ds.v*100, NULL) AS diskusage_percent FROM (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS id, argMax(Attributes['name'], TimeUnix) AS name, argMax(Attributes['type'], TimeUnix) AS type, argMax(Attributes['template'], TimeUnix) AS template FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_guest_info' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY id) g LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS id, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_up' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY id) u ON g.id=u.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS id, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_cpu_usage_limit' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY id) c ON g.id=c.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS id, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_memory_size_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY id) ms ON g.id=ms.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS id, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_memory_usage_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY id) mu ON g.id=mu.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS id, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_disk_size_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY id) ds ON g.id=ds.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS id, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_disk_usage_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY id) du ON g.id=du.id ORDER BY g.id

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['id'] AS id, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_cpu_usage_ratio' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND Attributes['id'] IN (SELECT Attributes['id'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_node_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, id ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['id'] AS id, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_cpu_usage_limit' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND Attributes['id'] IN (SELECT Attributes['id'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_node_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, id ORDER BY time

SELECT n.id AS id, n.v / nullIf(d.v,0) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS id, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_cpu_usage_ratio' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY id) n INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS id, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_cpu_usage_limit' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY id) d ON n.id=d.id WHERE 1=1 AND id IN (SELECT Attributes['id'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_node_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)

SELECT Attributes['id'] AS id, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_cpu_usage_limit' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND Attributes['id'] IN (SELECT Attributes['id'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_node_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) GROUP BY id

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['id'] AS id, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_memory_usage_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND Attributes['id'] IN (SELECT Attributes['id'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_node_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, id ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['id'] AS id, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_memory_size_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND Attributes['id'] IN (SELECT Attributes['id'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_node_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, id ORDER BY time

SELECT n.id AS id, n.v / nullIf(d.v,0) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS id, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_memory_usage_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY id) n INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS id, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_memory_size_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY id) d ON n.id=d.id WHERE 1=1 AND id IN (SELECT Attributes['id'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_node_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)

SELECT Attributes['id'] AS id, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_memory_usage_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND Attributes['id'] IN (SELECT Attributes['id'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_node_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) GROUP BY id

SELECT Attributes['id'] AS id, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_memory_size_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND Attributes['id'] IN (SELECT Attributes['id'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_node_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) GROUP BY id

SELECT r.time AS time, concat(g.name,' (',g.type,')') AS series, avg(r.v / nullIf(l.v,0)) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['id'] AS id, avg(Value) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_cpu_usage_ratio' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, id) r INNER JOIN (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['id'] AS id, avg(Value) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_cpu_usage_limit' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, id) l ON r.time=l.time AND r.id=l.id INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS gid, argMax(Attributes['name'], TimeUnix) AS name, argMax(Attributes['type'], TimeUnix) AS type FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_guest_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY gid) g ON r.id=g.gid WHERE r.id IN (SELECT Attributes['id'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_up' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes['id'] HAVING argMax(Value, TimeUnix)=1) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT r.time AS time, concat(g.name,' (',g.type,')') AS series, avg(r.v / nullIf(l.v,0)) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['id'] AS id, avg(Value) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_memory_usage_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, id) r INNER JOIN (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['id'] AS id, avg(Value) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_memory_size_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, id) l ON r.time=l.time AND r.id=l.id INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS gid, argMax(Attributes['name'], TimeUnix) AS name, argMax(Attributes['type'], TimeUnix) AS type FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_guest_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY gid) g ON r.id=g.gid WHERE r.id IN (SELECT Attributes['id'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_up' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes['id'] HAVING argMax(Value, TimeUnix)=1) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT storage, max(value) AS value FROM (SELECT s.storage AS storage, u.v / nullIf(z.v,0) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS id, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_disk_usage_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND Attributes['id'] LIKE 'storage/%' GROUP BY id) u INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS id, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_disk_size_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND Attributes['id'] LIKE 'storage/%' GROUP BY id) z ON u.id=z.id INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS sid, argMax(Attributes['storage'], TimeUnix) AS storage FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_storage_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY sid) s ON u.id=s.sid) GROUP BY storage

SELECT storage, max(value) AS value FROM (SELECT s.storage AS storage, z.v AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS id, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_disk_size_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND Attributes['id'] LIKE 'storage/%' GROUP BY id) z INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS sid, argMax(Attributes['storage'], TimeUnix) AS storage FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_storage_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY sid) s ON z.id=s.sid) GROUP BY storage

SELECT r.time AS time, concat(g.name,' (',g.type,')') AS series, avg(r.v / nullIf(l.v,0)) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['id'] AS id, avg(Value) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_disk_usage_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, id) r INNER JOIN (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['id'] AS id, avg(Value) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_disk_size_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, id) l ON r.time=l.time AND r.id=l.id INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS gid, argMax(Attributes['name'], TimeUnix) AS name, argMax(Attributes['type'], TimeUnix) AS type FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_guest_info' AND Attributes['type']='lxc' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY gid) g ON r.id=g.gid GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT b.time AS time, concat(g.name,' RECV (',g.type,')') AS series, b.v AS value FROM (SELECT time, id, sum(d) / greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS v FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['id'] AS id, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w=1, 0, if(raw_d<0, Value, raw_d)) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_network_receive_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, id) b INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS gid, argMax(Attributes['name'], TimeUnix) AS name, argMax(Attributes['type'], TimeUnix) AS type FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_guest_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY gid) g ON b.id=g.gid WHERE b.id IN (SELECT Attributes['id'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_up' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes['id'] HAVING argMax(Value, TimeUnix)=1) ORDER BY time

SELECT b.time AS time, concat(g.name,' SEND (',g.type,')') AS series, b.v AS value FROM (SELECT time, id, sum(d) / greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS v FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['id'] AS id, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w=1, 0, if(raw_d<0, Value, raw_d)) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_network_transmit_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, id) b INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS gid, argMax(Attributes['name'], TimeUnix) AS name, argMax(Attributes['type'], TimeUnix) AS type FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_guest_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY gid) g ON b.id=g.gid WHERE b.id IN (SELECT Attributes['id'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_up' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes['id'] HAVING argMax(Value, TimeUnix)=1) ORDER BY time

SELECT w.time AS time, concat(g.name,' (',g.type,')') AS series, (w.v+r.v) AS value FROM (SELECT time, id, sum(d) / greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS v FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['id'] AS id, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w=1, 0, if(raw_d<0, Value, raw_d)) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_disk_write_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, id) w INNER JOIN (SELECT time, id, sum(d) / greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS v FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['id'] AS id, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w=1, 0, if(raw_d<0, Value, raw_d)) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_disk_read_bytes' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$instance' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, id) r ON w.time=r.time AND w.id=r.id INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['id'] AS gid, argMax(Attributes['name'], TimeUnix) AS name, argMax(Attributes['type'], TimeUnix) AS type FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_guest_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY gid) g ON w.id=g.gid WHERE w.id IN (SELECT Attributes['id'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='pve_up' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes['id'] HAVING argMax(Value, TimeUnix)=1) ORDER BY time
